$comment: BridgeEscrow post-deploy config for Gnosis (100). See 1.json for field semantics. The bridge uses the LOGICAL symbol `USDC` (the source-chain symbol carried unchanged in the invoice) mapped here to the bridged USDC.e token 0x2a22f9c3 (its on-chain symbol() is 'USDC.e') — the token both supported bridges land on Gnosis. USD<->Gnosis works over BOTH Stargate AND the Gnosis omnibridge (operator picks per transfer): Stargate delivers this USDC.e directly, while the omnibridge delivers the LEGACY 'USD//C on xDai' token (0xDDAfbb50) and the Gnosis adapter swaps it 1:1 to this USDC.e via the immutable USDCTransmuter (0x0392a2f5). CCIP has no Gnosis USD token pool, so CCIP is disabled on Gnosis. WETH (0x6A02…) is a single token across every bridge, so it is unambiguous both ways.
